title: Peristaltic pump
text:
Precision in a closed-loop system is often the difference between a successful experiment and a failed hypothesis. For the engineers and solvers in the AoPS community, moving fluid is rarely just about volume; it is about the mathematical certainty of the dosage. This is where the modular peristaltic pump excels, offering a mechanical elegance that replaces complex valving with simple, predictable compression logic.

The core of this technology lies in its ability to isolate the media. Because the fluid only ever contacts the internal wall of the tubing, you eliminate the variables of cross-contamination and internal corrosion in one stroke. This is critical when your project involves volatile chemical reagents or delicate biological samples that require absolute purity.

Control is where the real engineering challenge begins. By utilizing a high-torque DC stepper motor, these units allow for micro-stepping integration that translates rotation into nanoliter resolution. Our current product architecture supports a versatile flow range, spanning from a meticulous 1ml/min for micro-fluidic titration up to 200ml/min for rapid system cycling. This wide dynamic range ensures that your hardware scales alongside your project’s complexity.

Reliability is built into the material science. With support for professional-grade Pharmed BPT and silicone tubing, the system maintains consistent flow rates even under the fatigue of continuous 24/7 operation. The compact, modular frame is designed specifically for the modern workbench, operating on standard 12V or 24V DC power to ensure seamless integration with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or custom PLC controllers.

Whether you are calculating the Reynolds number of a complex flow or building an automated lab-on-a-chip, the hardware should never be the bottleneck. By choosing a pump with a high-resolution motor and chemically-inert pathing, you shift the focus from troubleshooting mechanical failures back to solving the primary problem at hand. It is not just a pump; it is a precision instrument for those who demand total control over their environment. You can explore the full range of modular configurations and flow rate benchmarks here: https://www.ato.com/peristaltic-pump
